items.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
items.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

items.title: 'Scourge' of abuse must be rooted out, says Pope, during Lourdes visit
items.description: Pope Leo spoke to bishops before leading a service attended by thousands of worshippers in France.

items.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
items.description: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.

items.title: Killer Christa Pike is to be executed within days but her defence say she's a victim too
items.description: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.

items.title: Ten climbers missing after avalanche hits Himalayan base camp
items.description: The Nepali team was preparing to take overseas climbers up the Himlung Himal peak.

items.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
items.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

items.title: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
items.description: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia are in the path of the powerful storm.

items.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
items.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.

items.title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
items.description: Germany's education minister has branded the ban on the small brass memorial plaques a "scandal".

items.title: Republic of Ireland to wear black armbands for Israel game
items.description: Republic of Ireland players intend to wear black armbands "in recognition of all lives lost in the [Gaza] conflict" for match against Israel.

items.title: Mother of woman found hanging in tree shocked as police say body was staged
items.description: Christy Spivey tells the BBC she only has more questions now police think Tasia Fortune's body was put in the tree after her death.

items.title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared
items.description: Authorities said the heavy rains have subsided but the flooding is not yet over.

claude-code.description: A local control plane for Claude Code and Codex: every live session on your machine in one list — the ones you started by hand and the child agents your sessions dispatch.
